scope: Plan 0219 M1B through M2B ordinary lifecycle, minimum provider join, and isolated installed Alice/Bob acceptance
authority: Current user instruction, AGENTS.md, Plan 0219 version 3, and the active lane catalog
operativeRules: Use this capsule instead of broad policy rereads until a listed trigger fires.
Keep one primary owner and one existing worktree for the P219 critical path.
Batch one coherent causal group before Cargo and retain compact cargo-signal receipts.
Preserve the frozen SQLite, runtime-host, provider-owned presentation, Desktop Services, durable opaque handoff, and Alice/Bob replacement contract.
Treat provider-free, installed, external-viewer, and final-candidate evidence as distinct proof boundaries.
Use deterministic local tools for discovery, counters, formatting, schema checks, and test execution.
Reconcile the evidence ledger and custody at every material checkpoint; do not promote a row beyond the scope of its proof.
At 700000 renewed tokens, continue implementation only if M2B is directly evidenced as reachable before the 800000 implementation stop.
Stop early when M1B and M2A are complete and one frozen isolated-development candidate passes the complete M2B Alice/Bob checkpoint.
Use the final 200000 renewed tokens only for reconciliation, validation, evidence, custody, and a restart-safe handoff.
hardStops: No production or staging mutation, public ingress publication, merge, release, worktree deletion, private-site acceptance, or automatic external-workflow retry.
Provider, browser, installation, and isolated development effects require the exact Plan 0219 milestone prerequisites and a fresh identity and ownership preflight.
Stop for a scope change, unclassified architectural decision, failed ownership preflight, exhausted renewed budget, or inability to preserve the 200000-token closeout reserve.
Do not begin M3, M4, or M5 in this renewal after the alternative M2B outcome stop.
rereadWhen: The task scope, effect class, branch, worktree, owner, validation contract, or selected policy hash changes.
A failure exposes an ambiguity not resolved by this capsule.
